stories.title: EN DIRECT - Visite de Léon XIV à Metz : le pape loue l’importance de la réconciliation lors de sa dernière messe de sa visite historique

en.title: LIVE - Pope Leon XIV's visit to Metz: pontiff praises importance of reconciliation at final mass of historic visit
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV visited Metz, where he was greeted by crowds from his popemobile and blessed newborns. He celebrated mass at Metz Cathedral, emphasizing reconciliation during his final mass of the visit.

stories.title: Projet d’attaque contre la base militaire de Fairford au Royaume-Uni : enquête sur un lien avec l’Iran, selon la presse britannique

en.title: Investigation into planned attack on Fairford military base in United Kingdom: link with Iran being examined, according to British press
en.summary: Five British men suspected of preparing a terrorist act were arrested near the RAF Fairford base, which the U.S. military uses in operations related to Iran. Tehran denies any involvement in an alleged attack plan.

stories.title: Visite du pape à Metz : Léon XIV célèbre sa dernière messe en France dans une cathédrale comble

en.title: Pope's visit to Metz: Leon XIV celebrates his final mass in France in a packed cathedral
en.summary: The American pontiff celebrated his final French mass in a crowded Metz Cathedral. He previously delivered a speech lamenting war's return to European soil and called for courage in diplomatic negotiations.

stories.title: Au procès de Rachida Dati pour « corruption », le parquet fustige sa « volonté de capitaliser sur un mandat public pour engranger le plus de profits possible »

en.title: At Rachida Dati's trial for "corruption", prosecutors condemn her "willingness to capitalize on public office to generate maximum profits"
en.summary: On the final day of the corruption trial involving Rachida Dati and former Renault-Nissan CEO Carlos Ghosn, prosecutors requested serious penalties including four years imprisonment, with two years mandatory, against the 7th arrondissement mayor.

stories.title: Léon XIV à Metz : le pape bénit un bébé lors de sa déambulation

en.title: Leon XIV in Metz: Pope blesses baby during procession
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV traveled through Metz in his popemobile before celebrating mass at the cathedral, blessing a child named Lazare among gathered faithful.

stories.title: Blocus des lycées : Mélenchon dénonce une «répression» du gouvernement «avec un arrière-goût raciste», Lecornu évoque une «surenchère irresponsable»

en.title: High school blockades: Mélenchon denounces government "repression" with "racist undertones", Lecornu speaks of "irresponsible escalation"
en.summary: A confrontation erupted between the La France Insoumise political party and the government over blockades at high schools, with each side accusing the other of misconduct.

stories.title: Projet d'attaque contre une base militaire en Angleterre : les 5 hommes arrêtés sont britanniques

en.title: Alleged attack plot against British military base: 5 arrested men are British
en.summary: Five British men aged 23 to 25 were arrested near a military base in England used by American forces on suspicion of planning a terrorist attack.

stories.title: France : dernière messe pour le pape Léon XIV à Metz

en.title: France: final mass for Pope Leon XIV in Metz
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV celebrated his final mass in Metz at the Saint-Etienne cathedral during his visit to France.

stories.title: Léon XIV à Metz : ce qu'il faut retenir du discours du pape

en.title: Leon XIV in Metz: what to remember from the pope's speech
en.summary: The pope called for courage in negotiation and willingness to sacrifice certain positions for peace in Europe during the final day of his visit to France.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, voyage du pape à Metz : après un dernier « alléluia », Léon XIV sort de la cathédrale, où l’attend une foule de fidèles

en.title: Live: pope's trip to Metz: after a final "alleluia", Leon XIV leaves the cathedral, where a crowd of faithful awaits him
en.summary: The pope thanked those who organized his visit to Metz, including President Macron, civil authorities, and French church officials and volunteers.

stories.title: Léon XIV à Metz : le pape conditionne l’accueil des migrants à la «redécouverte de nos racines»

en.title: Leon XIV in Metz: the pope conditions the welcome of migrants to the "rediscovery of our roots"
en.summary: The pope advocated for migrant integration by calling for their inclusion into the family spirit of European society.

stories.title: Ce que l'on sait de l'enquête sur une attaque terroriste au Royaume-Uni après l'arrestation de cinq suspects près d'une base militaire

en.title: What we know about the investigation into a terrorist attack in the United Kingdom after the arrest of five suspects near a military base
en.summary: Five men suspected of planning an attack against a military base used by the U.S. military for operations in Iran were arrested over the weekend.

stories.title: Le Starship passe le cap de l’orbite

en.title: Starship reaches orbit milestone
en.summary: SpaceX's Starship achieved orbital flight for the first time on September 28, marking a historic milestone after three years of suborbital test flights.

stories.title: Retraites : pourquoi le gouvernement devrait privilégier la suppression de l’abattement de 10 %

en.title: Pensions: Government should prioritize removing 10% reduction
en.summary: The Public Policy Institute suggests that eliminating the 10% reduction applied to retirement pensions would be the most financially effective measure compared to raising the CSG or reducing pension indexation.

stories.title: Feux de forêt : prévention, urbanisme, financement… les pistes du rapport remis au gouvernement

en.title: Forest fires: Prevention, urban planning, funding discussed in government report
en.summary: Following a record-breaking summer of wildfires across France, the Prime Minister assigned seven parliamentarians to modernize civil security, and they have delivered their recommendations on prevention, planning and financing.

stories.title: OPINION. « Notre liberté d’action a un prix : la souveraineté »

en.title: "Our freedom of action has a price: sovereignty"
en.summary: An opinion piece argues that sovereignty, traditionally linked to state action and defense capabilities, has become essential to individual and collective freedom of action.

stories.title: Billets plus chers, moins de sièges : face au kérosène cher, les compagnies aériennes limitent la casse

en.title: Higher ticket prices, fewer seats: faced with expensive jet fuel, airlines limit the damage
en.summary: Airlines are confronted with rising fuel prices that diminish their hedging strategies' effectiveness. They are attempting to reduce losses, though some face potential bankruptcy.
